mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with semaglutide may cause severe hypertension and serotonergic effects due to increased noradrenergic activity and potential serotonin pathway interactions, particularly concerning given semaglutide's effects on appetite and glucose metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, use alternative antidepressant; if phenelzine must continue, monitor blood pressure closely and consider dose reduction of semaglutide with frequent clinical reassessment.
